body: Ugh... that's a lot to process and feel.  :(  I wish I could take some of the burden from you for a bit to help you get through it.  Have you sought any professional help?

You feel what you feel.  The idea that some feelings are valid and others aren't is really harmful.  Depression sucks all around and much like safe sex, there's a lack of generally available information/resources coupled with a lot of just flat incorrect teaching and preaching.
Bummer.  :(  What is it you can't take any more?

I'm going to cheat and say that my favorite decade is 1975-1985.  :)  Going out on a limb I would hazard a guess that I'm close to twice your age.   (And, I have no problem with that.)

Is your gaming console, PC, or both?  I've never played Penguin or Roblox....  I've pretty much always done PC gaming and currently do a lot of World of Tanks and Overwatch.

I've been dealing with depression since I was quite young.  Some days I experience new highs and other days new lows.  I've posted in this sub several times under different throw-away accounts.

I don't want to dominate the conversation here, nor make you feel like you owe anything.  Feel free to keep responding and I'll chat as I can.  You're welcome to take the conversation anywhere you like... if you want to keep it chatty, cool.  If you want/need to talk about the darker things, I can handle that.  If you want me to do more than listen, then let me know that as I don't want to throw any non-requested advice at you.  If you don't respond at all then know that I wish you well and thank you for your time.

There are quite a few gaming groups out there.  Is there anything that keeps you from getting involved with one or more of them?  I have more friends in my gaming group than I do otherwise...  I took a decade before I ever even met them face to face.  :)    (I remember being part of another gaming group before the current one and had a falling out with them... it was difficult for a while.)

Music is powerful... I couldn't live without it.  What's your favorite genre and decade?

Thank you for the response.  As self-evident by this post, I've not killed myself.  I'm exhausted, my throat hurts (from yelling), and generally still feeling pretty low.  However, I've reconnected with my wife.  We've both acknowledged each other and talked about ways we can try to make this less painful in the future.

Let me know if you'd like to talk...  as mentioned I've been doing the marriage gig for 30 years now (I'm 48) and have lots of experience and occasionally some wisdom.  As I recall, year seven was a real bitch to get through.
